newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS rates Canadian Natural paper program.
newsitem.headline: CBRS rates Canadian Natural paper program.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Friday it assigned an A-1/Prime Quality rating to Canadian Natural Resources Ltd's C$300 million commercial paper program with a stable outlook.
The rating relected the Canadian Natural's strong product margins, earnings and cash flow, CBRS said.
The company's commercial paper was recently expanded to C$300 million from C$200 million.

CBRS said CNQ's expanding production base was expected to compensate for the recent weakness in commodity prices and "superior earnings and cash flow" were still expected in 1997. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
